page.overview:
Who is Viltrumite Executioner 2?

Nolan (attempted victim) Battle Beast (killer)

The Viltrumite Executioner 2 was a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 to 3. He was one of the executioners of "The Great Nolan".

He was a Viltrumite warrior of the Viltrum Empire, dedicated to aiding the Viltrumite mission to make it the only empire in the universe. Ultimately, he was killed by Battle Beast.

Viltrumite Executioner 2 was a male with black hair sporting a well-groomed mustache.
